expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full code for selection.ts, api.ts, useSelection.ts, BulkActionsBar.tsx, DocumentsTable.tsx with all types and logic

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Complete React functional components with state management and event handlers—not recommendations or sketches

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Soft-delete to Trash; useRestoreBatch() mutation; toast includes 'undo: () => restore.mutate(batchId)' callback; message: 'They'll be kept for 30 days'

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: BulkActionsBar displays scope with count at top aria-live; DeleteConfirmDialog heading shows 'Move {count.toLocaleString()} {...} to Trash?'

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Selection discriminated union with kind:'explicit' vs kind:'query'; comment: 'The two are distinct variants, so every consumer has to say which one it handles'; selectPage and selectAllMatching create different types

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive: border border-slate-300 bg-white; Delete: text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50; visual separator span mx-2 h-5 w-px bg-slate-200

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive is primary-styled (white with border, comes first); Delete is text-only tertiary; Cancel button in dialog has autoFocus, not the destructive Confirm

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: Closing note: 'only the server can make it atomic...should reject when count ≠ expected'; 'idempotency key should be a unique index on the backend'; 'endpoints must enforce authorization themselves'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Closing section is a table with Mistake|Device columns listing: ambiguous select-all, stale filter selection, wrong archive target, wrong delete target, count drift, double-click, mis-click, empty selection; ends with 'Left possible on purpose'
